eventDetail.scope: International Russian Smart Industry Conference is devoted to discussion of the latest achievements in the field of automation and control systems. The conference is organized in order to exchange experiences, to promote the discussion and presentation of research papers, summarizing research in universities, industrial enterprises, scientific and industrial associations of the Russian Federation, as well as foreign authors, and research results obtained on the personal initiative of the authors.
